package idempotency

import (
	"context"

	"metaldocs/internal/platform/authn"
	"metaldocs/internal/platform/tenant"
)

// TenantActorFromContext mirrors the real internal/platform/idempotency/identity.go
// closely enough to matter for this fixture: it has the actorFromCtx shape
// (ctx context.Context) (string, string, error) and it calls
// tenant.FromContext(ctx) in its body — the exact form that WOULD fire this
// guard if the check's identity.go exclusion were ever removed.
//
// This file exists at scripts/testdata/guard-fixtures/idempotency-identity-scope-guard/
// internal/platform/idempotency/identity.go.txt, which copyTree materialises
// at exactly internal/platform/idempotency/identity.go inside the fixture
// sandbox — the one path the check excludes. Fixture.NotWant names this
// path: the check must stay silent about it while the exclusion holds, and
// go red the moment the exclusion is deleted (see the RED proof in the
// commit that added this fixture).
func TenantActorFromContext(ctx context.Context) (string, string, error) {
	tenantID, err := tenant.FromContext(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", err
	}
	actorID, err := authn.RequireUserID(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return "", "", err
	}
	return tenantID, actorID, nil
}
